live.instructions:
Evaneos connects travelers with local travel agencies that design tailor-made trips. This server helps users find where to travel.

Before calling suggest_destinations: if the request is very vague (e.g. "I want to travel"), ask one short question about what they want to experience or when they plan to go. Do not ask more than one round of questions; call the tool as soon as you have an interest or a constraint.

After results are shown: the carousel already displays each destination, so do not list or re-describe them in text. Write two or three sentences on why these destinations fit the request, then offer to refine (period, duration, travel companions, other regions) or to look at the sample itineraries of the one they prefer.

Follow the sustainableGuidelines returned with the results: suggest shoulder-season dates or less crowded alternatives when relevant.

tools.name: suggest_destinations
tools.title: Suggérer des destinations
tools.description: Use this when the user is looking for trip inspiration and has not chosen a destination yet: they describe what they want to experience (nature, culture, beaches, hiking, food...) and/or their constraints (travel period, trip length, children, transport modes to avoid, continent) and want to know where to go. Returns a short list of matching destinations displayed in an interactive carousel. Each destination includes an introduction, a highlights summary, the best time to visit, photos, and up to 3 sample tailor-made itineraries designed with Evaneos local travel agencies. Call it again with updated arguments when the user refines their criteria or asks for other ideas, and list destinations already shown or rejected in excluded_destinations. Do not use when the user has already picked a single destination and wants details, prices, an itinerary or a quote for it; for flight, hotel or car rental bookings; for practical travel questions (visas, weather, health, currency); or for requests unrelated to travel.

travel_interests.description: What the user wants to experience during their trip. Can range from vague desires (e.g., 'see nature', 'relax') to specific activities (e.g., 'cycling tours and beach yoga'). Capture all expressed wishes and constraints in natural language.

traveling_with_children.description: Set to true if the user mentions traveling with children or kids.

travel_period.description: List of months when the user wants to travel, in ISO 8601 format ('MM'). Infer from vague expressions like 'next summer' or 'around Christmas'. Example: ['03', '04'] for March-April.

duration_days.description: Desired trip length in days. Convert expressions like 'two weeks' to the equivalent number of days (e.g., 14).

excluded_transports.description: Transport modes the user wants to avoid. Allowed values: 'plane', 'car', 'train', 'boat'. Use when the user expresses preferences like 'no flying', 'avoid boats', or 'no road trips' (→ car).

excluded_destinations.description: Destinations the user wants to exclude from suggestions, for any reason (already visited, not interested, too expensive, etc.). Use destination names as they appear in available destinations. Examples: ['Thailand', 'Japan']

continents.description: Continent preferences when the user explicitly mentions continent names or refers to continental regions. Set this field whenever the user says phrases like 'in Europe', 'somewhere in Asia', 'African destinations', 'travel to South America', 'a country in Oceania', etc. Match the user's intent even if they use variations like 'European destinations' → 'Europe' or 'Asian countries' → 'Asia'.
